confidence_notes: Restaurant and cafe anchors come from Lisbon cost-of-living guides and crowd-sourced indexes with mixed dates. Some figures are euro-based and were converted at an assumed EUR to USD rate of about 1.15, which I did not verify by search. Cocktail and wine anchors rest on tourism-board ranges and one crowd-sourced cocktail figure, with the wine price set relative to beer. Accommodation anchors are holistic model estimates for July peak season, not based on live listings or searches. The FX value (0.6947 for 2026-10-16) was read from an RBA exchange-rates page search summary; I did not open the full F11.1 table to confirm it.
comparable_city_reasoning: Lisbon-specific sources (Lisbon Tourism Board ranges, Portugalist, Flatio, Expatistan, GetWhereNext USD estimates) for food and drink. Accommodation is a holistic estimate anchored to Western European capital-city summer pricing, with Lisbon's peak-season premium assumed.
